اعتلين (form VIII)
# اِعْتَلَيْنَ (iʕtalayna) /iʕ.ta.laj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# اُعْتُلِينَ (uʕtulīna) /uʕ.tu.liː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# اِعْتَلِينَ (iʕtalīna) /iʕ.ta.liː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
